mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 above 5% for 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in expansion phases are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises above 4.5% for the next month, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are expected to be negative due to labor market stress.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 and INDPRO above their 5-quarter moving averages signal economic expansion, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The proxies' concurrent increase does not occur, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS < 4%), a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 3.5% for 2 months predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In the 'monetary easing cycle' regime, the FEDFUNDS decline does not predict positive returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDPC1 and PAYEMS together above their 3-month moving averages signal labor demand growth, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The proxies' increase doesn't occur, or 20-day returns aren't significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls below 110 for the next month, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are expected to be negative due to contractionary supply.
failure_condition: INDPRO doesn't fall below 110, or returns aren't negative (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 4.5% for 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as labor market improves.
failure_condition: The UNRATE decline doesn't sustain for 3 months, or 60-day returns aren't significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% and CPIAUCSL remains below 2%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are expected to be positive due to controlled monetary tightening.
failure_condition: The FEDFUNDS >5% and CPIAUCSL <2% combination doesn't occur, or returns aren't positive (t-test p > 0.05).
